title: Cooperative Vehicle-to-Everything Point Cloud Perception: Training, Evaluation, and Export Code for the Mixed Signals Dataset
description:
Code, configurations, trained checkpoint, and evaluation tools for V2X cooperative 3D object detection (car, bike, pedestrian) on the Mixed Signals dataset. The detector is an OpenCOOD-based PointPillars model with intermediate attention fusion across roadside and connected-vehicle LiDARs.

Included: a compatibility layer for the current dataset release, a corrected BEV-IoU evaluator, the epoch-55 reference checkpoint (84.5% mAP on the held-out development split), fusion-strategy baselines, pose-sensitivity, score-calibration and node-composition analyses with block-bootstrap confidence intervals, and the export script for the challenge's test split. The scored test-split prediction archives are attached to the repository's final-predictions release.

Licensing: the original code is MIT; the bundled starter kit keeps its academic research licence; the checkpoint and prediction archives are derived from the Mixed Signals dataset and follow its CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 licence.
